**C.** The ordinance is content-neutral, serves the significant interest in keeping public parks clean, and is unrelated to suppressing speech, so under the *O'Brien* test it can be enforced even if the dumping was expressive conduct. A and D overstate the protection (expressive conduct can still be regulated), and B's clear-and-present-danger test concerns incitement, which the facts don't raise.

CONFIDENCE: 82
